skills.name: Kappa Shell
skills.description: Throws shell at enemies. Bad effects on enemies.  *Continuously cancels enemy invincibility (5 sec) *Makes enemy skills unusable (5 sec) *ATK x 3300% Area Damage

skills.name: Kappa Jewel
skills.description: Kappa Moon rejoices with his jewel. Good effects on surrounding allies.  *ATK +300% (12 sec) *Critical Damage +400% (12 sec) *Changes regular attacks to area attacks (12 sec)

abilities.name: Resistance: Enemy Cost Increase
abilities.description: Rangers with this Ability block enemies' Cost Increase Abilities.  - Affected Abilities: Enemy Cost Increase, Enemy Cost Increase 2

abilities.name: Shield Pierce
abilities.description: Normal attack damage dealt by Rangers with the target Abilities ignores enemy shield effects.  - Pierce applies to: Shield (Skill), HP buffs (Skill, Talent), Super Shield (Ability), Blood Veil (Gear) - Guardians, Bosses, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability
